title: publications.json
description: Where an agent folder has been published. Lives beside cinna-agent.json at the agent root, is excluded from cloud import, and is absent until the first publish. It is a sibling of the manifest and not a key inside it because it is a mutable per-instance sync ledger rather than identity, and because each entry records a content_hash OF the exported tree - a tree the manifest is a member of, so a hash written into the manifest could never match the tree it describes. The top level is an object, not a bare array, so a later contract can add a sibling key without a breaking change to readers that already read `publications`. Unknown keys are preserved for forward compatibility.

publications.description: One entry per Cinna instance this agent was published to. Written only by a publish/import step. An update resolves the entry whose platform_url matches the instance it runs against.

platform_url.description: Origin of the instance, e.g. https://acme.opencinna.io.

agent_id.description: Id of the agent created on that instance.

workspace.description: Account workspace the CLI pushed from, relative to the workshop root, e.g. Cloud/acme.opencinna.io. Absent when the desktop published directly through the account API.

contract_version.description: Contract version the folder was pushed with.

content_hash.description: Hash of the exported tree at the last push, over the files that survive both cloud_import_excludes and the secret_files rules in layout.json. A mismatch against the current export means the instance is behind.
